Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name of the cardholder, which is usually the full name.

MiddleName.name: Middle Name
MiddleName.definition: Middle name or initials present in the name of a person.

Designation.name: Designation
Designation.definition: Identifies the specific cardholder when multiple cardholders are associated with the same account.

BillingAddress.name: Billing Address
BillingAddress.definition: Complete billing address of the cardholder.

CompressedAddress.name: Compressed Address
CompressedAddress.definition: Compressed billing address of the cardholder

ShippingAddress.name: Shipping Address
ShippingAddress.definition: Complete shipping address of the cardholder.

DateOfBirth.name: Date Of Birth
DateOfBirth.definition: Date of birth of the party.

HighValue.name: High Value
HighValue.definition: Identifies a cardholder that is a highly valued individual (e.g., Very Important Person).

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.

LocalData.name: Local Data
LocalData.definition: Contains text fields in the local language.
